rca_of_issue: Reproduction: Go to /library, type '432 Hz' in archive-search-input, tap archive-tab-alpha then archive-tab-codex. Actual: input value becomes empty. Expected: retain full typed value and focus behavior. Likely cause: tab-change handler clears query state during view transitions. Mitigation: preserve query unless explicit reset action is invoked.
